title: 懸索橋主纜除濕系統~Suspension-cable dehumidification systems
focus: 以露點、流路壓降、包覆氣密、除濕機容量與生命週期決策，設計並驗證主纜乾燥空氣系統~Designing and verifying main-cable dry-air systems through dew point, flow-path pressure drop, wrap airtightness, dehumidifier capacity and life-cycle decisions
summary: 主纜內部的水分會先消耗鍍鋅層、再腐蝕高強度鋼絲，而主纜幾乎無法更換。本課以本州四國連絡橋首創的主纜乾燥空氣送氣（管理目標相對濕度 40%）與大貝爾特東橋 2014 至 2015 年的除濕改造為主軸，說明腐蝕門檻與露點、送氣與排氣流路、彈性體包覆與索夾密封、除濕機與預冷、改造施工與啟動乾燥曲線、感測器判讀與開纜比對，最後以能耗與生命週期比較說明業主如何決策。~Moisture inside a main cable first consumes the zinc and then corrodes high-strength wire, and the cable can almost never be replaced. Built around the Honshu-Shikoku bridges' pioneering dry-air cable injection (managed to 40% relative humidity) and the 2014–2015 dehumidification retrofit of the Great Belt East Bridge, this course explains corrosion thresholds and dew point, injection and exhaust flow paths, elastomeric wrapping and cable-band seals, dehumidifiers and pre-coolers, retrofit construction and the start-up dry-out curve, sensor interpretation and comparison with cable openings, and finally energy use and the life-cycle comparison behind an owner's decision.

units.anchor: 主纜內部露點~Dew point inside the cable
units.title: 主纜為何從內部腐蝕~Why cables corrode from the inside
units.mechanism: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲平行排列，鋼絲之間約有兩成空隙。水分在紡線或牽引期間隨雨水進入，也會從纏絲裂縫、索夾邊緣與吊索附近滲入，並在主纜低點聚積。白天日照加熱、夜間輻射冷卻，主纜內部空氣反覆「呼吸」，帶入潮濕空氣；當鋼絲表面溫度低於空氣露點，水氣就凝結在鋼絲上。本州四國連絡橋拆開舊橋纏絲時發現鋼絲已經生鏽，大貝爾特東橋的業主也參考了福斯公路橋的腐蝕教訓，這些經驗說明外部塗裝無法保證內部乾燥。~A main cable holds tens of thousands of parallel wires with about one-fifth of its section as voids. Water enters with rain during spinning or hauling and later seeps in through cracked wrapping, cable-band edges and around hangers, collecting at low points. Daytime sun heats the cable and night-time radiation cools it, so the air inside breathes in and out, drawing in humid air; when the wire surface falls below the air's dew point, vapour condenses on the wires. The Honshu-Shikoku authority found rust on wires when it removed the wrapping of older bridges, and the Great Belt owner drew on corrosion found on the Forth Road Bridge, showing that external paint cannot guarantee a dry interior.
units.model: Magnus 式露點 T_d = b·γ/(a − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T)，a = 17.62、b = 243.12 °C。纜內空氣 25 °C、80% RH：γ ≈ −0.223 + 1.643 = 1.420，T_d ≈ 21.3 °C，夜間鋼絲只要降到 21 °C 以下就結露；若纜內維持 40% RH，T_d ≈ 10.5 °C，結露機會大幅降低。溫濕度為教學假設。~Magnus dew point T_d = b·γ/(a − γ), with γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T), a = 17.62 and b = 243.12 °C. For cable air at 25 °C and 80% RH: γ ≈ −0.223 + 1.643 = 1.420 and T_d ≈ 21.3 °C, so wires cooling below 21 °C at night collect condensation; held at 40% RH, T_d ≈ 10.5 °C and condensation becomes much rarer. Temperatures and humidities are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在主纜低點與高點各置溫濕度探頭與鋼絲表面溫度計，連續記錄數週，計算每小時露點與鋼絲溫度差，統計結露時數；同時在低點開窗檢查積水與鍍鋅狀態，確認量測推論與實況一致。~Place humidity and temperature probes and wire-surface thermometers at cable low and high points, record continuously for several weeks, compute hourly dew point against wire temperature and count condensation hours; open an inspection window at a low point to check for standing water and zinc condition, confirming that inference matches reality.
units.failure: 主纜低點長期積水時，鍍鋅層先被消耗，接著鋼絲出現點蝕與應力腐蝕裂紋；由於外層纏絲完好，問題往往在數十年後開纜檢查才被發現，屆時斷絲與強度損失可能已需要限載或補強。~Where water sits at low points for years, zinc is consumed first and then wires pit and develop stress-corrosion cracks; because the outer wrapping looks intact, the problem is often found only at a cable opening decades later, when broken wires and strength loss may already require load limits or strengthening.
units.misconception: 主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。~With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
units.practice: 新建懸索橋應在設計階段就把主纜除濕列為防蝕系統的一部分，並在施工期間限制雨中紡線或牽引、在擠壓前排水；既有橋梁則以溫濕度量測與開窗檢查建立現況基準，再決定是否改造。~New suspension bridges should include cable dehumidification in the corrosion-protection design from the start, limiting spinning or hauling in rain and draining before compaction; for existing bridges, establish a baseline by humidity measurement and inspection windows before deciding on a retrofit.

units.anchor: 送氣與排氣流路~Injection and exhaust path
units.title: 系統構成與送氣間距~System layout and injection spacing
units.mechanism: 主纜除濕系統由除濕機組、風機、送氣管、送氣套筒、氣密包覆、排氣套筒與感測器組成。乾燥空氣從送氣套筒進入主纜，沿鋼絲間的空隙向兩側流動，一路吸收水分，再從一定距離外的排氣套筒排出。主纜空隙像多孔介質，流量與壓差成正比、與流動距離成反比，因此送氣與排氣的間距、送氣壓力與包覆所能承受的壓力，三者必須一起設計。大貝爾特東橋的業主說明，包覆與索夾周圍的密封就是為了讓空氣能在進氣與排氣套筒之間流動。~A cable dehumidification system consists of dehumidifier units, fans, supply ducts, injection sleeves, an airtight wrap, exhaust sleeves and sensors. Dry air enters the cable at an injection sleeve, flows both ways through the voids between wires picking up moisture, and leaves at exhaust sleeves some distance away. The cable voids behave like a porous medium, with flow proportional to pressure difference and inversely proportional to flow distance, so sleeve spacing, supply pressure and the pressure the wrap can hold must be designed together. The Great Belt owner explains that the wrapping and the seals around the clamps exist precisely so that air can flow between the inlet and exhaust sleeves.
units.model: 以 Darcy 式估算 Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L)。取等效滲透率 k = 1×10⁻⁹ m²、流動斷面 A = 0.6 m²、壓差 Δp = 2,000 Pa、空氣黏滯係數 μ = 1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s：流動距離 L = 150 m 時 Q ≈ 4.4×10⁻⁴ m³/s（約 27 L/min）；L 增為 300 m，Q 減半為約 13 L/min。k 與壓差為教學假設。~Estimate with Darcy's law Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L). With equivalent permeability k = 1×10⁻⁹ m², flow section A = 0.6 m², pressure difference Δp = 2,000 Pa and air viscosity μ = 1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s: a flow length L = 150 m gives Q ≈ 4.4×10⁻⁴ m³/s (about 27 L/min); doubling L to 300 m halves Q to about 13 L/min. k and the pressure difference are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在代表性區段以不同送氣壓力量測進、排氣口流量，反算等效滲透率，確認設計間距下的流量足以在目標時間內乾燥；若不同區段的滲透率差異很大，調整送氣分配或增設套筒。~On representative sections measure inlet and exhaust flow at several supply pressures, back-calculate equivalent permeability and confirm that flow at the design spacing dries the section in the target time; where permeability varies widely between sections, rebalance supply or add sleeves.
units.failure: 送氣間距過大或壓力不足，遠離送氣口的區段幾乎沒有流量，排氣口讀值卻可能因為近端空氣短路而看似乾燥；壓力過高則超過包覆與索夾密封的承受能力，造成鼓起、剝離與大量洩漏。~Spacing too long or pressure too low leaves sections far from the inlet with almost no flow, while exhaust readings may still look dry because air short-circuits near the inlet; pressure too high exceeds what the wrap and band seals can hold, causing bulging, debonding and heavy leakage.
units.misconception: 只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。~Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.
units.practice: 系統設計報告應列出每個區段的長度、預估滲透率、設計壓力與流量、包覆容許壓力與排氣目標，並在試運轉時以實測值更新；任何區段流量偏低都要在交接前處理。~The system design report should list each section's length, estimated permeability, design pressure and flow, wrap pressure limit and exhaust target, updated with measured values at commissioning; any section with low flow must be resolved before handover.

units.anchor: 彈性體包覆與索夾密封~Elastomeric wrap and band seals
units.title: 氣密包覆與索夾密封細部~Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details
units.mechanism: 傳統的鍍鋅軟鋼纏絲加防蝕膏與塗裝並不氣密，乾燥空氣會從纏絲縫隙大量逸出。除濕系統因此改用強化彈性體帶材包覆，以重疊纏繞並加熱熔合成連續的氣密外殼；大貝爾特東橋即以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆主纜，並在索夾周圍密封。系統的弱點通常不在包覆本身，而在不連續處：索夾兩端、吊索穿出處、送排氣套筒與檢查開口。這些位置要用專用的密封件與填充材，並能承受溫度循環與主纜的微小變形。~Traditional soft galvanised wrapping wire with paste and paint is not airtight, and dry air escapes in quantity through its gaps. Dehumidification systems therefore use reinforced elastomeric tape wound with overlaps and heat-fused into a continuous airtight skin; the Great Belt East Bridge was wrapped with Cableguard reinforced elastomer and sealed around its cable clamps. The weak points are usually not the wrap itself but the discontinuities: both ends of each band, hanger exits, injection and exhaust sleeves and inspection openings. These need dedicated seals and fillers that tolerate temperature cycles and small cable movements.
units.model: 洩漏口流量 Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ)。取 C_d = 0.6、洩漏面積 1 cm²（1×10⁻⁴ m²）、壓差 2,000 Pa、空氣密度 1.2 kg/m³：流速 √(2×2,000/1.2) ≈ 57.7 m/s，Q ≈ 0.6×10⁻⁴×57.7 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ m³/s（約 208 L/min），比上一單元整段主纜約 27 L/min 的流量大七倍以上。數值為教學假設。~Leak flow Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ). With C_d = 0.6, a 1 cm² leak (1×10⁻⁴ m²), 2,000 Pa and air density 1.2 kg/m³: velocity √(2×2,000/1.2) ≈ 57.7 m/s and Q ≈ 0.6×10⁻⁴×57.7 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ m³/s (about 208 L/min), more than seven times the roughly 27 L/min flowing through a whole cable section in the previous unit. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 包覆熔合時記錄環境溫度、濕度、熔合溫度與搭接寬度，抽樣做剝離試驗；每區段完成後封閉做壓力保持試驗，以肥皂水或超音波檢漏器沿索夾邊緣與套筒逐一檢查，修補後再試驗。~During wrap fusion log ambient temperature, humidity, fusion temperature and lap width, with sample peel tests; after each section, seal it for a pressure-hold test and check band edges and sleeves one by one with soapy water or an ultrasonic leak detector, retesting after repair.
units.failure: 一個未密封的索夾端或破損的搭接，就能讓大部分乾燥空氣在近端逸出，下游區段持續潮濕；包覆在低溫或潮濕時熔合，日後在溫度循環下沿搭接開裂，雨水反而從裂縫進入。~One unsealed band end or broken lap can vent most of the dry air near the inlet while downstream sections stay damp; wrap fused in cold or wet weather can split along laps under later thermal cycles, letting rain in through the cracks.
units.misconception: 包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。~The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.
units.practice: 施工規範應規定熔合的環境條件、搭接寬度、索夾與套筒的標準密封細部，以及每區段的氣密驗收；索夾螺栓再張拉、吊索更換或檢查開口後，都必須按同一細部恢復密封並重新試驗。~The specification should set environmental limits for fusion, lap width, standard seal details at bands and sleeves and airtightness acceptance per section; after bolt re-tensioning, hanger replacement or inspection openings, the seal must be restored to the same detail and retested.

units.anchor: 除濕機與預冷~Dehumidifier and pre-cooler
units.title: 除濕機組容量與預冷設備~Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers
units.mechanism: 主纜除濕常用吸附式除濕機：空氣通過含吸濕劑的轉輪，水氣被吸附，轉輪另一側以加熱空氣再生，把水分排到外面。吸附式在低溫下仍能產生很低露點的空氣，適合送入主纜。本州四國連絡橋在夏季高濕時加裝預冷設備，先以冷卻盤管把外氣降溫凝結出一部分水，再送入除濕機，減輕轉輪負荷。機組容量必須依最不利季節的外氣條件、總送氣量與目標送氣濕度決定，並保留備援。~Cable systems commonly use desiccant dehumidifiers: air passes through a rotor carrying a desiccant that adsorbs vapour, while the other side of the rotor is regenerated with heated air that carries the moisture outside. Desiccant units deliver very low dew-point air even at low temperatures, which suits cable injection. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges added pre-coolers for humid summers: cooling coils lower outdoor air temperature and condense part of its water before it reaches the dehumidifier, easing the load on the rotor. Unit capacity must be set from outdoor air in the worst season, total supply flow and target supply humidity, with redundancy.
units.model: 水氣密度：30 °C、80% RH 約 24.2 g/m³；25 °C、20% RH 約 4.6 g/m³。每立方公尺需除去約 19.6 g，送氣 10 m³/min 時約 11.8 kg/h。若先預冷到 15 °C 飽和（約 12.8 g/m³），凝結去除約 11.4 g/m³，吸附轉輪只需處理約 8.2 g/m³，即原負荷的約 42%。數值為教學假設。~Vapour density: about 24.2 g/m³ at 30 °C and 80% RH, about 4.6 g/m³ at 25 °C and 20% RH. Each cubic metre must lose about 19.6 g, about 11.8 kg/h at 10 m³/min. Pre-cooling to saturation at 15 °C (about 12.8 g/m³) condenses about 11.4 g/m³, leaving the desiccant rotor only about 8.2 g/m³, about 42% of the original load. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 工廠驗收時量測機組在多種進氣溫濕度下的出氣露點與流量，確認符合規格曲線；現場以進、出口溫濕度與流量計算實際除濕量，與設計值比較，並記錄再生溫度與轉輪轉速，作為日後性能退化的基準。~At factory acceptance measure outlet dew point and flow over a range of inlet conditions against the specification curve; on site compute actual moisture removal from inlet and outlet humidity and flow, compare with design, and record regeneration temperature and rotor speed as the baseline for later degradation.
units.failure: 若以年平均氣候選機，夏季高濕時送氣濕度超標，纜內濕度回升；機組單點故障而無備援，維修期間整段主纜停止送氣；預冷盤管凝結水排放不良則可能結冰或回流進送氣管。~Sizing units on annual-average climate lets supply humidity exceed target in humid summers so cable humidity climbs; a single unit failing without redundancy stops injection to a whole section during repair; poor condensate drainage from pre-cooler coils can freeze or run back into the supply duct.
units.misconception: 除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。~Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do.
units.practice: 採購規範應以設計外氣條件、送氣露點、流量、備援數量、遠端監控介面與維修可及性定義機組；機房位置要考慮維修人員的安全通道與設備吊運路線，並保留更換整台機組的空間。~Define units in the procurement specification by design outdoor conditions, supply dew point, flow, redundancy, remote-monitoring interface and maintainability; locate plant rooms with safe access for maintenance staff and a lifting route, leaving space to replace a complete unit.

units.anchor: 既有主纜改造順序~Retrofit sequence on a live cable
units.title: 既有主纜的除濕改造施工~Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable
units.mechanism: 大貝爾特東橋的主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成，是在橋梁持續通車下進行的改造。典型流程是：清理既有纏絲與塗裝表面、修補局部損傷，在索夾兩端與吊索處安裝密封件，在選定位置安裝送氣與排氣套筒，然後以彈性體帶材沿主纜纏繞並熱熔，最後連接送氣管、機組與感測器。作業沿主纜在臨時平台或纜上移動式設備上進行，進度受風、雨與溫度限制，因為熔合需要乾燥表面與足夠溫度。~The Great Belt East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015 while the bridge stayed open. A typical sequence is to clean the existing wrapping and paint, repair local damage, fit seals at both ends of each band and at hanger exits, install injection and exhaust sleeves at chosen positions, wind and heat-fuse elastomeric tape along the cable, then connect ducts, units and sensors. Work proceeds along the cable from temporary platforms or travelling equipment, and progress is limited by wind, rain and temperature, because fusion needs a dry surface and enough warmth.
units.model: 兩條各約 3 km 的主纜共 6,000 m。若每組人員每日可完成 40 m 包覆，需 6,000/40 = 150 組日；4 組同時作業約 37.5 個可施工日。若只有 50% 的日子符合熔合的天候條件，約需 75 個日曆天，尚未計入套筒與索夾密封。數值為教學假設。~Two cables of about 3 km each make 6,000 m. At 40 m of wrapping per crew per day, the job needs 6,000/40 = 150 crew-days; with 4 crews working together, about 37.5 workable days. If only 50% of days meet the weather conditions for fusion, it takes about 75 calendar days, before sleeves and band seals are added. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每日記錄施工區段、天候、熔合參數與完成長度，對未達條件的日子停止熔合；每完成一個送排氣區段就做氣密試驗，合格後才能進入下一段；纜上設備的荷重、錨固與防墜措施由臨時工程設計者核可。~Log section, weather, fusion parameters and length completed each day, stopping fusion when conditions are not met; test each injection–exhaust section for airtightness before moving on; have the temporary-works designer approve loads, anchorage and fall protection of on-cable equipment.
units.failure: 為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。纜上設備若固定不當，也可能刮傷包覆或纏絲。~Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts; incomplete cleaning traps old paint or paste under the wrap, spoiling adhesion and possibly holding water; poorly secured on-cable equipment can also scratch the wrap or wrapping wire.
units.misconception: 除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。~A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather.
units.practice: 改造合約應把天候限制、熔合參數、逐段氣密試驗與纜上作業安全列為停留點，並要求承包商提交每日紀錄；交通管制與高空作業許可由業主統一協調，任何設備附掛在主纜上都需要結構工程師核可。~The retrofit contract should make weather limits, fusion parameters, section-by-section airtightness tests and safety of work on the cable hold points, with daily records from the contractor; the owner coordinates traffic management and work-at-height permits, and anything attached to the cable needs the structural engineer's approval.

units.anchor: 啟動乾燥曲線~Start-up dry-out curve
units.title: 啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減~Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay
units.mechanism: 系統啟動時，主纜內可能有多年累積的水分，排氣口的相對濕度一開始接近飽和，隨著殘留水分被帶走而逐漸下降，最後趨近由送氣濕度與持續滲入量決定的穩定值。下降曲線通常近似指數衰減，時間常數取決於殘留水量、送氣流量與水分從鋼絲間隙蒸發的速度。本州四國連絡橋以 40% RH 為管理目標，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有餘裕；調試時就是看排氣濕度何時、能否穩定落在目標以下。~At start-up the cable may hold years of accumulated moisture, so exhaust relative humidity begins near saturation, falls as trapped water is carried away and finally approaches a steady value set by supply humidity and continuing ingress. The decline is usually close to exponential, with a time constant set by the amount of trapped water, supply flow and how fast water evaporates from the wire interstices. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges manage to 40% RH, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; commissioning watches when, and whether, exhaust humidity settles below that target.
units.model: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ)。取 RH₀ = 90%、RH_∞ = 30%、τ = 20 天：降到 40% 所需 t = τ·ln[(90 − 30)/(40 − 30)] = 20×ln 6 ≈ 35.8 天。若某區段 τ 實測為 40 天，則需約 72 天；若 RH_∞ 高於 40%，曲線永遠到不了目標。數值為教學假設。~RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ). With RH₀ = 90%, RH_∞ = 30% and τ = 20 days, reaching 40% takes t = τ·ln[(90 − 30)/(40 − 30)] = 20×ln 6 ≈ 35.8 days. A section with a measured τ of 40 days needs about 72 days; if RH_∞ is above 40%, the curve never reaches the target. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個區段從啟動起逐日記錄排氣溫濕度與流量，以指數曲線擬合 τ 與 RH_∞，預測達標日期；擬合的 RH_∞ 高於目標的區段，優先檢查洩漏、送氣量與局部積水，必要時開窗排水。~From start-up log exhaust humidity, temperature and flow daily for each section, fit τ and RH_∞ to an exponential curve and forecast the date of reaching target; for sections whose fitted RH_∞ exceeds the target, check leaks, supply flow and local standing water first, opening a window to drain if needed.
units.failure: 若調試只看最初幾天的下降就宣告完成，可能遺漏下降停滯在目標以上的區段；排氣濕度長期偏高卻被歸因於天候，延誤找出洩漏或積水點，主纜持續在潮濕狀態。~Declaring commissioning complete after a few days of decline can miss sections that stall above target; blaming persistently high exhaust humidity on weather delays finding leaks or standing water, and the cable stays damp.
units.misconception: 除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。~Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
units.practice: 調試規範應定義每個區段的達標準則（例如連續 30 天排氣濕度低於目標）、擬合方法與未達標時的處理流程；調試紀錄與擬合參數納入交接文件，作為日後判斷性能退化的基準。~The commissioning specification should define the success criterion per section, for example 30 consecutive days of exhaust humidity below target, the fitting method and the procedure when targets are missed; commissioning records and fitted parameters go into the handover file as the baseline for judging later degradation.

units.anchor: 排氣溫濕度感測器~Exhaust humidity sensors
units.title: 感測器網路與露點裕度判讀~Sensor network and dew-point margin
units.mechanism: 除濕系統的效果只能透過量測看見，感測器至少包括各送氣口與排氣口的溫度、相對濕度與流量，以及代表性位置的鋼絲表面溫度。電容式濕度感測器會隨時間漂移，在高濕或含鹽環境下更快，因此需要定期校正或以可攜式參考儀比對。判讀時不應只看相對濕度，而要把空氣露點與鋼絲溫度比較：相對濕度看似達標，若夜間鋼絲溫度接近露點，仍可能結露。~The effect of a dehumidification system can only be seen through measurement: at minimum temperature, relative humidity and flow at each injection and exhaust point, plus wire-surface temperature at representative locations. Capacitive humidity sensors drift with time, faster in humid or salty conditions, so they need periodic calibration or comparison with a portable reference. Interpretation should not rest on relative humidity alone but compare air dew point with wire temperature: humidity may look on target while night-time wire temperature approaches the dew point and condensation still occurs.
units.model: 排氣空氣 20 °C、40% RH 時露點約 6.0 °C；若夜間鋼絲 8 °C，裕度約 2.0 °C。感測器誤差 ±3% RH 時，40% 的讀值可能代表 37% 至 43%，露點約 4.9 至 7.0 °C，裕度只剩約 1.0 °C。數值為教學假設。~Exhaust air at 20 °C and 40% RH has a dew point of about 6.0 °C; with wires at 8 °C at night the margin is about 2.0 °C. With ±3% RH sensor error, a 40% reading may mean 37% to 43%, a dew point of about 4.9 to 7.0 °C, leaving a margin of only about 1.0 °C. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝前逐只校正感測器並記錄序號，安裝後每年以可攜式參考儀現場比對，偏差超過允許值即更換；監控平台應同時計算露點與鋼絲溫度差，設定警報門檻，並檢查資料缺漏與時間同步。~Calibrate every sensor before installation and record serial numbers, compare annually on site with a portable reference and replace any beyond tolerance; the monitoring platform should compute dew point against wire temperature, set alarm thresholds and check for data gaps and time synchronisation.
units.failure: 感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。~A sensor drifting low makes the system look on target while the cable is actually damp; a failed sensor stuck at a constant value, if undetected, can hide for years that a section has lost its supply.
units.misconception: 只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。~If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation.
units.practice: 監測規範應要求每個感測器的校正紀錄、年度現場比對、資料完整率門檻與「讀值長期不變」的異常偵測規則；警報要有明確的負責人與處理時限，並在每年的維護報告中彙整。~The monitoring specification should require calibration records for every sensor, annual field comparison, a data-completeness threshold and a rule to detect readings that never change; alarms need a named owner and response time, summarised in the annual maintenance report.

units.anchor: 濕潤時間與開纜比對~Time of wetness versus openings
units.title: 成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查~Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings
units.mechanism: 除濕的目的不是讀值好看，而是讓鋼絲不再腐蝕，因此最終驗證要回到鋼絲本身。ISO 9223 以相對濕度高於 80% 且溫度高於 0 °C 的累計時數定義濕潤時間，作為大氣腐蝕性的指標之一；把纜內監測資料換算成濕潤時間，可以量化除濕前後的腐蝕環境差異。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊指出，膜包覆與除濕在亞洲已廣泛使用、歐洲也有應用，並建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時以聲學監測偵測斷絲；監測資料與下一次開纜檢查的腐蝕分級、斷絲數比對，才能確認系統真正有效。~The aim of dehumidification is not good readings but wires that stop corroding, so final verification returns to the wires themselves. ISO 9223 defines time of wetness as accumulated hours with relative humidity above 80% and temperature above 0 °C, one indicator of atmospheric corrosivity; converting in-cable monitoring data into time of wetness quantifies the change in corrosive environment before and after dehumidification. The US Federal Highway Administration primer notes that membrane wrapping and dehumidification are widely used in Asia and also in Europe, and recommends acoustic monitoring for wire breaks once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found; only comparing monitoring data with corrosion stages and broken-wire counts at the next cable opening confirms that the system works.
units.model: 若除濕前纜內每年 RH > 80% 的時數為 4,000 h（約 46% 的時間），除濕後降為 80 h（約 0.9%），濕潤時間減少約 98%。若腐蝕速率約與濕潤時間成正比，鋅層消耗年數由 10 年級延長到數百年級。比例關係為教學簡化。~If, before dehumidification, the cable spends 4,000 h a year above 80% RH (about 46% of the time) and afterwards 80 h (about 0.9%), time of wetness falls by about 98%. If corrosion rate scales roughly with time of wetness, zinc life stretches from the order of ten years to the order of centuries. The proportionality is a teaching simplification.
units.verify: 把每個區段的監測資料逐年換算成濕潤時數與露點裕度，選擇改造前曾有腐蝕的位置在數年後開窗，以相同的楔線與分級方法記錄，與改造前結果並列比較；聲學監測事件則對照開窗位置確認是否為斷絲。~Convert each section's monitoring data into annual wet hours and dew-point margin, reopen windows some years later at locations that showed corrosion before the retrofit, recording with the same wedge lines and staging method for side-by-side comparison; check acoustic events against opening locations to confirm whether they were wire breaks.
units.failure: 只以排氣濕度證明成效而從未開纜比對，可能長期誤判；已經產生裂紋的鋼絲即使在乾燥環境中也不會恢復強度，若未把改造前的劣化納入評估，可能高估剩餘安全係數。~Proving effectiveness only by exhaust humidity, never by reopening the cable, can mislead for years; wires already cracked do not regain strength in dry air, so ignoring pre-retrofit damage can overstate the remaining safety factor.
units.misconception: 裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。~Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again.
units.practice: 業主應把除濕系統的監測資料、聲學監測與開纜檢查整合成同一套主纜狀態評估，訂出改造後的首次複查時程（例如數年內一次），並在評估報告中分開記載改造前的既有損傷與改造後的新增變化。~The owner should combine dehumidification monitoring, acoustic monitoring and cable openings into one cable-condition assessment, set the first post-retrofit re-inspection (for example within a few years), and record existing pre-retrofit damage separately from new changes in the assessment report.

units.anchor: 風機與再生能耗~Fan and regeneration energy
units.title: 運轉能耗與設備維護~Running energy and plant maintenance
units.mechanism: 除濕系統需要數十年連續運轉，能耗與設備維護是營運成本的主要部分。能耗來自兩處：推動空氣通過管路與主纜空隙的風機，以及加熱再生空氣使吸附轉輪恢復吸濕能力的加熱器，後者通常較大。維護項目包括過濾器更換、轉輪與密封檢查、風機軸承、預冷盤管清潔與凝結水排放、控制系統與感測器校正。本州四國連絡橋的經驗也顯示，系統需要依實際運轉持續改善，例如針對夏季高濕加裝預冷設備。~A dehumidification system runs continuously for decades, so energy and plant maintenance dominate operating cost. Energy goes in two places: fans that push air through ducts and cable voids, and heaters that warm regeneration air to restore the desiccant rotor, the latter usually being larger. Maintenance covers filter changes, rotor and seal checks, fan bearings, pre-cooler coil cleaning and condensate drainage, and control-system and sensor calibration. The Honshu-Shikoku experience also shows that a system needs continuous improvement from operating data, such as adding pre-coolers for humid summers.
units.model: 風機功率 P = Q·Δp/η。取 Q = 0.2 m³/s、Δp = 3,000 Pa、效率 η = 0.5：P = 0.2×3,000/0.5 = 1,200 W。再生加熱器 10 kW、平均負載率 50%，年耗電約 10×8,760×0.5 = 43,800 kWh，遠大於風機的約 10,500 kWh。若預冷降低吸附負荷四成，再生能耗可望同步下降。數值為教學假設。~Fan power P = Q·Δp/η. With Q = 0.2 m³/s, Δp = 3,000 Pa and efficiency η = 0.5: P = 0.2×3,000/0.5 = 1,200 W. A 10 kW regeneration heater at 50% average duty uses about 10×8,760×0.5 = 43,800 kWh a year, far more than the fan's roughly 10,500 kWh. If pre-cooling cuts the desiccant load by 40%, regeneration energy can fall in step. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以電錶分別記錄風機、再生加熱與預冷的耗電，與除濕量、外氣條件一起分析每公斤除濕量的能耗趨勢；能耗上升而除濕量不變時，檢查過濾器堵塞、轉輪劣化或洩漏增加。~Meter fan, regeneration and pre-cooler consumption separately and analyse energy per kilogram of moisture removed against outdoor conditions; when energy rises for the same moisture removal, check for clogged filters, rotor deterioration or increased leakage.
units.failure: 為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。~Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks; filters left unchanged raise pressure drop and cut flow, and a control system that watches only whether fans are running may never alarm.
units.misconception: 除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。~Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance.
units.practice: 維護手冊應列出各設備的檢查週期、更換零件清單、能耗基準與性能退化判斷準則，並把能耗與除濕量的比值作為年度報告的關鍵指標；任何節能措施都必須先評估對纜內濕度的影響。~The maintenance manual should list inspection intervals, spare parts, energy baselines and degradation criteria for every item of plant, with energy per unit of moisture removed as a key annual indicator; any energy-saving measure must first be assessed for its effect on cable humidity.

units.anchor: 除濕與重塗的生命週期~Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle
units.title: 除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策~Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出，大貝爾特東橋通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，原本規劃的是重新塗裝，業主最後選擇投入更高的初始費用安裝密封除濕系統。這個決策的關鍵在於：重新塗裝只能維持外層，無法處理已進入主纜內部或日後滲入的水分；而主纜一旦因腐蝕需要補強或限載，代價遠高於任何防蝕措施。本州四國連絡橋以 200 年以上的使用為目標、以預防保全降低生命週期成本，也是同一邏輯。決策時必須把不確定的未來劣化風險放進比較。~Public accounts note that after about 15 years in service no rust had been found in the Great Belt East Bridge cables; repainting had been planned, but the owner chose a higher initial outlay on a sealed dehumidification system. The key is that repainting only maintains the outer skin and does nothing about water already inside the cable or entering later, while a cable that needs strengthening or load limits because of corrosion costs far more than any protection. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges' target of 200 years or more, with preventive maintenance to minimise life-cycle cost, follows the same logic. The decision must bring the uncertain risk of future deterioration into the comparison.
units.model: 以相對成本單位、折現率 3%、100 年比較。重塗每 15 年 1.0 單位：現值 ≈ 1 + 0.642 + 0.412 + 0.264 + 0.170 + 0.109 + 0.070 ≈ 2.67。除濕初設 4.7、年運轉 0.05（年金係數 31.6）、每 25 年更換設備 0.8：現值 ≈ 4.7 + 1.58 + 0.65 ≈ 6.93。差額 4.26 單位，若重塗方案在第 50 年有 50% 機率需要 37 單位的主纜介入，其期望現值 0.5×37×0.228 ≈ 4.22，兩者接近打平。數值為教學假設。~Compare in relative cost units at 3% discount over 100 years. Repainting at 1.0 unit every 15 years has a present value ≈ 1 + 0.642 + 0.412 + 0.264 + 0.170 + 0.109 + 0.070 ≈ 2.67. Dehumidification at 4.7 initial, 0.05 a year (annuity factor 31.6) and 0.8 for plant renewal every 25 years has ≈ 4.7 + 1.58 + 0.65 ≈ 6.93. The difference is 4.26 units; if the repainting option carries a 50% chance of a 37-unit cable intervention at year 50, its expected present value 0.5×37×0.228 ≈ 4.22 nearly closes the gap. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 決策文件應列出現況檢查與開纜結果、各方案的成本與時程假設、劣化與介入機率的依據，並做折現率、劣化速率與介入成本的敏感度分析；由業主的技術委員會審查，並在改造後依實測資料檢討假設。~The decision file should set out current inspection and opening results, cost and timing assumptions for each option, the basis for deterioration and intervention probabilities, and sensitivity analyses on discount rate, deterioration rate and intervention cost; the owner's technical committee reviews it, and assumptions are revisited with measured data after the retrofit.
units.failure: 只比較直接工程費而不考慮主纜劣化風險，會系統性地偏向延後投資；等到開纜發現大量第 4 級腐蝕或斷絲才改造，除濕雖可阻止惡化，卻無法恢復已損失的強度。~Comparing only direct works cost without cable-deterioration risk systematically favours delay; retrofitting only after openings reveal widespread Stage 4 corrosion or broken wires stops further damage but cannot restore the strength already lost.
units.misconception: 主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。~Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money.
units.practice: 業主應在資產管理計畫中明列主纜防蝕策略的決策準則、檢討週期與觸發條件，並把除濕系統的設計、調試、監測與維護資料作為完整的交接包，確保日後的管理者能延續同一套證據鏈。~The owner's asset-management plan should state the decision criteria, review cycle and triggers for cable corrosion strategy, and hand over the dehumidification design, commissioning, monitoring and maintenance records as one package so future managers inherit the same chain of evidence.

example: 設計練習：為一段 300 m 的主纜區段規劃送氣。主纜直徑 0.87 m、空隙率 20%，空隙體積約 0.594×0.20×300 ≈ 35.7 m³。若在中央送氣、兩端排氣，每側流動距離 150 m；以等效滲透率 1×10⁻⁹ m²、流動斷面 0.6 m²、壓差 2,000 Pa 估算，每側流量約 27 L/min，合計約 53 L/min（3.2 m³/h），每天換氣約 76.8 m³，約為空隙體積的 2.2 倍。送入 25 °C、15% RH 空氣（約 3.4 g/m³），出口 40% RH（約 9.2 g/m³），每天可帶走約 0.44 kg 水。若段內殘留 10 kg 水，約需 23 天；若改為只在一端送氣、另一端排氣，流動距離 300 m 使流量減為約 13 L/min，乾燥時間增為約 91 天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: plan injection for a 300 m cable section. The cable is 0.87 m in diameter with 20% voids, a void volume of about 0.594×0.20×300 ≈ 35.7 m³. Injecting at mid-length with exhausts at both ends gives a 150 m flow length each way; with equivalent permeability 1×10⁻⁹ m², flow section 0.6 m² and 2,000 Pa, each side carries about 27 L/min, about 53 L/min (3.2 m³/h) in total, or about 76.8 m³ a day, about 2.2 times the void volume. Injecting air at 25 °C and 15% RH (about 3.4 g/m³) with exhaust at 40% RH (about 9.2 g/m³) removes about 0.44 kg of water a day, so 10 kg of trapped water takes about 23 days. Injecting at one end and exhausting at the other makes the flow length 300 m, cutting flow to about 13 L/min and stretching drying to about 91 days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 本州四國連絡橋公團檢查較早完成的懸索橋時，拆開鍍鋅纏絲後發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，因而開發了把乾燥空氣送入主纜內部的系統，業主稱其為世界首創，管理目標為相對濕度 40%，並安裝在所有本四懸索橋，之後再針對夏季高濕加裝預冷設備。歐洲的懸索橋在發現主纜腐蝕後陸續採用彈性體包覆與除濕，大貝爾特東橋於 2014 至 2015 年完成改造；美國聯邦公路總署 2012 年的入門手冊也指出這類系統在亞洲廣泛使用、歐洲已有應用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~When the Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority inspected its earlier suspension bridges and found rust on wires beneath the galvanised wrapping, it developed a system to inject dry air into the main cables, which the owner calls a world first, managed to 40% relative humidity and installed on all its suspension bridges, later adding pre-coolers for humid summers. European suspension bridges adopted elastomeric wrapping and dehumidification after cable corrosion was found, the Great Belt East Bridge completing its retrofit in 2014–2015, and the US Federal Highway Administration's 2012 primer noted that such systems are widely used in Asia and have been used in Europe. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

較早的因島、大鳴門與 1988 年通車的瀨戶大橋，原以鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲防護主纜~Earlier bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto and Seto Ohashi (opened 1988) originally relied on galvanised wire, rust inhibitor and wrapping

大貝爾特東橋以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆兩條約 3 km 長的主纜並密封索夾~The Great Belt East Bridge wrapped its two cables, each about 3 km long, in Cableguard reinforced elastomer with sealed clamps
新尾道大橋鋼箱梁內部以乾燥空氣維持 60% RH 以下，內表面積約為外表面的 4 倍~Dry air keeps the Shin-Onomichi box girder interior at 60% RH or less; its inner surface is about 4 times the outer
ISO 9223 以 RH 高於 80% 且溫度高於 0 °C 的累計時數定義濕潤時間~ISO 9223 defines time of wetness as hours with RH above 80% and temperature above 0 °C
FHWA 建議發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時，以聲學監測 12 至 18 個月偵測斷絲~FHWA recommends 12 to 18 months of acoustic monitoring for wire breaks once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found
25 °C、80% RH 空氣的露點約 21 °C，40% RH 時約 10.5 °C~Air at 25 °C and 80% RH has a dew point of about 21 °C, about 10.5 °C at 40% RH
